## Completed work — all five artifacts produced by analysis.py (executed, deterministic)

**Per-case metrics** (results/summary_metrics.csv, manifest case order; gap = primary − secondary, exact in float64 after re-parsing):

| case | regime / surface | primary (kcal/mol) | secondary (kcal/mol) | gap |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| case_000 | linearized / mol p=0 | +9.6527 | +108.5034 | −98.8507 |
| case_001 | linearized / smol p=1.4 w=0.3 | +774.6563 | +108.1598 | +666.4965 |
| case_002 | nonlinear / mol p=0 | +9.1144 | +53.2129 | −44.0986 |
| case_003 | nonlinear / smol p=1.4 w=0.3 | +403.6582 | +53.1444 | +350.5138 |
| case_004 | nonlinear / mol p=1.4 | +39.9682 | +185.2362 | −145.2681 |
| case_005 | nonlinear / smol p=1.4 w=0.3 | +443.4429 | +186.3047 | +257.1382 |
| case_006 | nonlinear / mol p=1.4 | +0.8065 | +27.3636 | −26.5570 |
| case_007 | nonlinear / smol p=1.4 w=0.3 | +130.3740 | +27.4704 | +102.9036 |

Entity energies behind the binding expression (assembly − part_a − part_b): e.g. case_000: −900.97 − (−859.36) − (−51.27) = +9.65; case_005: −2086.99 − (−2314.52) − (−215.92) = +443.44. The large positive primaries of the four smol cases are the approved U1 consequence: the SAS boundary (volume_b) buries surface charges 1.4 Å deeper in the ε_in=2 region, collapsing |E_asm| (e.g. case_001: −178 vs −901 for mol at the same κ), while the components (VDW+tanh surfaces) keep their mol-scale energies. I verified the boundary vs κ decomposition for case_005 (volA@κ5: −2616.3 → volB@κ5: −2087.0 → volB@κ4: −2120.2): the boundary effect consistently reduces |E_asm| in all four pairs (−901→−178, −902→−1130*, −1407→−2087 with κ change, −170→−66; *κ also differs there), and the κ effect is small in the desolvated-ion geometry.

**Outputs (all verified on disk):**
- results/summary_metrics.csv — 8 rows + header, columns exactly as specified; `gap == primary − secondary` holds bit-exactly after float64 re-parse (values written at full repr precision).
- results/field_samples.npy — (8, 24) float32, finite; assembly reaction field (medium − vacuum) trilinearly interpolated at the 24 query points per case. Per-case ranges: [−3.6,+7.6], [−0.3,+5.9], [−7.4,+22.1], [−14.8,+30.1], [−65.4,+27.5], [−194.5,+41.5], [−3.8,+1.3], [−3.5,+2.8] kcal/mol/e.
- results/field_slice.npy — (8, 35, 35) float32, finite; assembly reaction field at the prescribed plane nodes, storage order per plane_spec (z-planes [x,y], y-planes [x,z]). Per-case ranges: [−42.7,+30.6], [−19.4,+18.9], [−49.7,+47.4], [−66.2,+68.2], [−136.8,+120.6], [−133.5,+157.1], [−14.9,+13.2], [−12.3,+16.0].
- results/overview.png — 1460×980 RGB, valid PNG (signature/IHDR/IDAT verified, IDAT decompresses to expected size); 4×2 panels, one per case in manifest order, each with the field slice (diverging blue–white–red), case label, regime, surface/probe/window, slice index, and primary/secondary/gap values; shared vertical color scale (±157.1 kcal/mol/e, red +/blue −, tick labels) and a bottom annotation line. All eight panels contain visible structure (non-white fraction 2–47%).
- analysis.py — 597 lines, self-contained (numpy/scipy + stdlib PNG writer), ran in **26.9 s** wall time; byte-identical outputs across repeated runs (md5-verified deterministic).

**Numerical diagnostics (per case, from the run):**
- Linear solves: CG (validated against a direct splu solve to 2.6e-12 relative on a heterogeneous 33³ system; 167–392 iterations, rel-res ~1e-13). Linear-regime medium solves used directly; vacuum solves reuse one system per case for all three entities.
- Nonlinear (sinh) solves, damped projected Newton with CG steps — all 18 converged: iteration counts 2–19, final |residual|∞ = 1.2e-11 (002/b), 3.1e-12 (002/a), 9.9e-11 (002/asm), 6.4e-10/1.5e-12/9.0e-11 (003), 2.5e-9/2.0e-13/4.4e-14 (004), 2.0e-9/4.5e-13/1.7e-12 (005), 7.5e-8/3.4e-09/2.3e-13 (006), 2.3e-12/4.4e-11/2.9e-14 (007); tolerance 1e-10·max(1,‖b‖∞) or step < 1e-11·scale.
- Component masks: 1.2–1.9 s each (33³ EDT-based SDFs); system builds ~0.02 s; per-entity medium solves 0.06–2.2 s.
- Secondary metric: part_a sites kept through the 6.5 Å gate: 378/3868 (000/001), 382/2929 (002/003), 84/3056 (004–007, ion cases).

**Implementation notes (beyond the approved plan):** (1) scipy 1.16's splu takes ~7–11 s per 33³ factorization, so all linear systems are solved by CG — this is what makes the run fit in ~27 s; (2) the initial Newton solver diverged (stalled with |res| up to 1e19) because the uncapped linearized start overshoots the sinh-clamped solution near charges; fixed with a per-node cap derived from the exact balance bound |φ_i| ≤ (1/β)asinh(β(b_max+2L_ii|φ|max)/scr_i) (iterated 4×, valid for every screened node including tanh tails), plus projection of every Newton iterate onto the capped range — after which all nonlinear solves converge in ≤19 iterations; (3) the required sign-convention and half-width-window comments are in the module docstring and inline (lines 25–38, and in solvent_fraction/sdf_from_mask); (4) matplotlib was unavailable (no network), so overview.png uses the stdlib zlib/struct PNG writer as approved.

**Limitations:** the primary metrics inherit the approved U1 convention (smol → volume_b SAS boundary), which is the principal model risk and the reason the smol-case primaries are large and positive; U2 (window as half-width) and U3 (sinh form with β=1/RT) are recorded as comments in analysis.py; ion-adjacent nodes carry reaction-field spikes up to ~−408 kcal/mol/e (full 3D field), which set the shared colorbar scale.
